text:
harry: PSA 9am: found a yogurt in the back of the fridge that had... upgraded to a science project. :sweat_smile: please check dates and toss stuff older than 5 days?
sana: Oh no. Im guilty  that was mine, forgot about the plain Greek. Sorry everyone. Will toss and apologize to the cult of clean fridges. :grimacing:
lina: No shame. Small ask: can we do a 2-week "snack census" board so we know what's community vs personal? Labels + date would help.
oliver: Agree with census. Also, could we add a tiny QR code sticker to the shared jars that links to the pantry spreadsheet? Makes quick updates easier.
pantry-bot: Suggestion logged: "2-week snack census + QR stickers". React with :+1: to approve purchase of printable sticker sheets.
ops-bot: Facilities note: removed expired yogurt at 09:12 and disinfected shelf. Fridge temp stable at 4.1°C. If you notice spills, flag #kitchen-ops. (automated)
harry: Thanks ops! Quick policy idea: if you open a shared tub, write name + date and put a sticky on the lid. Anything older than 5 days -> toss. Short and fair.
sana: I can start the census and bring a pack of sticky date labels. Also volunteering to be on the "first munch" duty this week (check expiry).
lina: Hero. Also tiny ledger idea: a communal "snack jar" where we track kitty contributions. Could be a physical jar + a one-line entry in the sheet. Sample format:
```
2026-03-22 | oliver | $5 | beans
2026-03-23 | sana | $3 | honey
```
Simpler than Venmo threads.
oliver: Love the ledger. I'll make a printable ledger card and tape it near the jar. Also happy to buy labels if someone adds $5 to the kitty.
pantry-bot: Generated shopping list based on suggestions:
- sticker sheets x1
- sticky date labels x1 pack
- small clear jar (for kitty)
- marker x1
(see tinyurl.com/pantry-ops to contribute)
harry: Also tiny etiquette: please cool hot food before fridge. Found a steaming dumpling box making the shelf sweats. :sweat_drops:
sana: noted. I'll put up a 3-line sticky: "Label, Date, Cool" near the fridge tonight.
ops-bot: Purchase request submitted for sticker sheets + labels + jar. Ticket #4412. ETA 3 business days.
lina: Thanks team. To make the census low-effort, I'll print a small table for the fridge door: Name | Item | Date | Community? (Y/N). Whoever wants to opt in will fill a row.
oliver: I'll laminate it so it lasts. Free coffee for whoever fills the first five rows. :coffee:
pantry-bot: Reminder: update the shared pantry sheet after purchases: tinyurl.com/pantry-ops.
harry: Great. Looks like we fixed the science project and have a plan. Ill brave the toaster for the free coffee. :crossed_fingers:
